purpose: Catalog of acquired RedM downloads and settings guides, with coverage limited to observed channel posts and local exports.

policy.excludedContent: No Lua, bypass scripts, or FiveM resources are included.
policy.downloads: Staged attachments retain original bytes. Graphics overlays retain selected original data files, and settings guides document source instructions.
policy.previews: Only original source images or decoded source frames may be verified; no video thumbnails are presented as extracted frames.
policy.credits: Display names and suggested download filenames omit the requested source suffix. Original attachment bytes, author notices, original source names, and private provenance are retained.
policy.history: No channel is claimed as exhaustively inspected.

items.versionBasis: The inspected source post does not identify a numbered release version.

items.description: UI duration data shared for quicker map and pause-menu transitions and scrolling.
requirements: RedM client installation.
Place durations.xml in RedM Application Data/citizen/common/data/ui. Create the ui folder if it is absent.

items.name: No Grass Settings
items.description: A system.xml setting for reducing grass draw distance in RedM.
items.credits: Shared in RedM Hub by MEE6.
requirements: RedM client installation.
Back up %APPDATA%/CitizenFX/rdr3_settings/system.xml. Open it and change the existing grassLod value to -3.000000. Save the file.
items.compatibility: Install according to the supplied source instructions. Runtime behavior has not been independently tested.
items.versionBasis: No explicit numbered release version was established in the reviewed source.
items.changelogStatus: No independently reviewed author changelog recorded.
items.previewCaption: Original screenshot supplied with this resource.

items.name: Low Graphics Settings
items.description: A lower graphics settings preset for RedM.
items.credits: Shared in RedM Hub by 021.
requirements: RedM client installation.

Back up %APPDATA%/CitizenFX/rdr3_settings/system.xml. In your own file, replace the section from the first line through the closing </advancedGraphics> tag with the matching section from the download. Keep everything below that tag from your existing file.
items.compatibility: Install according to the supplied source instructions. Runtime behavior has not been independently tested.
items.versionBasis: No explicit numbered release version was established in the reviewed source.
items.changelogStatus: No independently reviewed author changelog recorded.
items.previewCaption: Original screenshot supplied with this resource.

items.name: Weapon Keybinds
items.description: A guide to assigning keys for quickly drawing weapons.
items.credits: Shared in RedM Hub by 021.
requirements: RedM client installation.

Open the pause menu and go to Settings → Controls → Mouse & Keyboard → Key Mapping. Select the weapon actions you want to bind, then assign your preferred keys. The source screenshot shows the German menu.
items.compatibility: Install according to the supplied source instructions. Runtime behavior has not been independently tested.
items.versionBasis: No explicit numbered release version was established in the reviewed source.
items.changelogStatus: No independently reviewed author changelog recorded.
items.previewCaption: Original screenshot supplied with this resource.

items.name: Stretched Resolution
items.description: A full screen configuration for the 1440 × 920 resolution shown in the source guide.
items.credits: Shared in RedM Hub by 021.
requirements: RedM client installation.
Back up your RedM system.xml. Set its screen dimensions to 1440 × 920 and select full screen. Set the same resolution in the display settings, then use Alt+Enter if the game is still windowed.
items.compatibility: Install according to the supplied source instructions. Runtime behavior has not been independently tested.
items.versionBasis: No explicit numbered release version was established in the reviewed source.
items.changelogStatus: No independently reviewed author changelog recorded.

items.name: Colors.xml Design Update
items.description: Original shared colors.xml design update for the RedM interface.
items.credits: File header credit: Jeremy Tudisco. Shared by 021 in RedM Hub. Original file notices are retained unchanged.
requirements: RedM client installation.
Place this preset as colors.xml in RedM Application Data/citizen/common/data/ui.
Turn colorblindness mode OFF in the in-game settings under Display.
Choose one colors.xml preset for this destination; another preset replaces the same filename.

items.versionBasis: No numbered preset release version was stated. ColorData v2.0 is the XML format marker, not a verified release version.
